extracted.intended_audience: rail carriers (esp. those filing abandonment notices), potential offerors of financial assistance, affected employees, local governments and agencies, environmental/historic stakeholders, and practitioners filing pleadings with the Surface Transportation Board
extracted.subtask_description: A Surface Transportation Board Federal Register notice announcing an abandonment exemption filing and specifying the certifications, procedural requirements, filing deadlines, and conditions (employee protection, OFA, stays, environmental review) that govern the exemption process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verified notice certifications
rubrics_metrics.description: LSRC has certified that: (1) no local traffic has moved over the Line for at least two years; (2) no overhead traffic could be or was previously handled on the stub-ended Line; (3) no formal complaint filed by a user of rail service on the Line (or by a state or local government on behalf of such user) regarding cessation of service over the Line is pending with either the Surface Transportation Board (Board) or any U.S. District Court or has been decided in favor of a complainant within the past two years; and (4) the requirements at 49 CFR 1105.7(b) and 1105.8(c) (notice of environmental and historic reports), 49 CFR 1105.12 (newspaper publication), and 49 CFR 1152.50(d)(1) (notice to government agencies) have been met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These certifications are part of the verified notice filed under 49 CFR part 1152 subpart F; if any of these certifications are false or misleading, the exemption is void ab initio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accuracy of verified notice (void if false/misleading)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the verified notice contains false or misleading information, the exemption is void ab initio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing inaccurate information can nullify the exemption from the outset; parties should ensure truthfulness and completeness of statements in the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employee protection condition and revocation process
rubrics_metrics.description: As a condition to this exemption, any employee adversely affected by the abandonment shall be protected under Oregon Short Line Railroad—Abandonment Portion Goshen Branch Between Firth & Ammon, in Bingham & Bonneville Counties, Idaho, 360 I.C.C. 91 (1979).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To address whether this condition adequately protects affected employees, a petition for partial revocation under 49 U.S.C. 10502(d) must be filed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer of Financial Assistance (OFA) procedure and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Provided no formal expression of intent to file an offer of financial assistance (OFA) has been received, this exemption will be effective on June 8, 2025, unless stayed pending reconsideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Persons interested in submitting an OFA must first file a formal expression of intent to file an offer, indicating the type of financial assistance they wish to provide (i.e., subsidy or purchase) and demonstrating that they are preliminarily financially responsible. See 49 CFR 1152.27(c)(2)(i). Filing fees for OFAs are specified at 49 CFR 1002.2(f)(25).

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline for petitions to stay (non-environmental issues)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to stay that do not involve environmental issues must be filed by May 19, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Board will grant a stay if an informed decision on environmental issues cannot be made before the exemption's effective date. Any request for a stay should be filed as soon as possible so the Board may take appropriate action before the exemption's effective date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions to reopen and public use condition requests deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions to reopen and requests for public use conditions under 49 CFR 1152.28 must be filed by May 29, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely filing is required to seek reopening of the proceeding or imposition of public use conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trail use/railbanking and interim requests deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Interim trail use/railbanking requests under 49 CFR 1152.29 and formal expressions of intent to file an OFA under 49 CFR 1152.27(c)(2) must be filed by May 19, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing fees for trail use requests are referenced at 49 CFR 1002.2(f)(27). Parties should follow the regulatory procedures and deadlines for trail use and OFA filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental/historic report filing and Draft EA comment period
rubrics_metrics.description: LSRC has filed a combined environmental and historic report. OEA will issue a Draft Environmental Assessment (Draft EA) by May 16, 2025. Comments on environmental or historic preservation matters must be filed within 15 days after the Draft EA becomes available to the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Draft EA will be available on the Board's website, by writing to OEA, or by calling OEA at (202) 245-0294. If an accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act is required, call (202) 245-0245.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential imposition of environmental, preservation, public use, or trail use conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: Environmental, historic preservation, public use, or trail use/railbanking conditions will be imposed, where appropriate, in a subsequent decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affected parties should timely submit environmental/historic comments or public use/trail use requests to influence whether and what conditions are imposed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of consummation requirement and expiration of authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to 49 CFR 1152.29(e)(2), LSRC shall file a notice of consummation with the Board to signify that it has exercised the authority granted and fully abandoned the Line. If consummation has not been effected by LSRC's filing of a notice of consummation by May 9, 2026, and there are no legal or regulatory barriers to consummation, the authority to abandon will automatically expire.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The carrier must file the notice of consummation by the specified date to preserve the abandonment authority; failure to consummate by that date results in automatic expiration of authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pleading filing and service requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: All pleadings, referring to Docket No. AB 534 (Sub-No. 4X), must be filed with the Surface Transportation Board either via e-filing on the Board's website or in writing addressed to 395 E Street SW, Washington, DC 20423-0001. In addition, a copy of each pleading must be served on LSRC's representative, Thomas J. Litwiler, Fletcher & Sippel LLC, 29 North Wacker Dr., Suite 800, Chicago, IL 60606-3208.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing must reference the docket number and comply with the Board's filing methods; service on the carrier's representative is required for each pleading.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of Board decisions and contact/access information
rubrics_metrics.description: Board decisions and notices are available at www.stb.gov. The Draft EA will be available on the Board's website and can also be requested by mail or phone from OEA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interested persons should check the Board website for documents and follow the provided contact methods for accessing environmental materials.
